name: Sacred Pragmatist
description: Has one inviolable principle and is flexible on everything else
behavioral_signature: Bends all rules except the one that defines them
under_stress: Everything becomes negotiable except that one thing
at_rest: Easygoing about most things, immovable on one
will_always: protect their sacred principle at any cost
will_never: reveal what their line is until it's crossed
unless: the principle was based on a misunderstanding they finally see clearly
